pr.body:
This archive makes 43 generated Shan Hai Jing identity candidates reviewable in GitHub. It includes transparent raster artwork, exact generation prompts, revision notes, initial passage audits across all 18 chapters and a provisional theme catalogue. Earlier candidates and failed anatomy revisions are preserved as history; the deployed collection is unchanged and no candidate is user-approved.

The newest batch adds SHJ-044 赤鷩, SHJ-045 萆荔, SHJ-046 文莖 and SHJ-047 條（符禺山葵狀）, with two-view R01/R02 sheets and source research. Qianyang (042) R03 removes the residual visible human pinna; haircut turnaround consistency still needs review. 文莖 (046) and 條 (047) retain ear-root anatomy issues despite R02 and remain pending refinement. Fine botanical detail, frame margins and final production-style review are recorded limitations, not silently marked complete.

Kaiming (039) has separate front R04b and three-quarter R04 candidates reviewed as nine complete human heads with attached necks; earlier two-view R01–R03 sheets show seven heads per view and remain failed-count history. Lu Wu (038) R03 was reviewed as nine visible tail tips per view. Tongqu (043) R02 preserves the full tail tip with only 17 pixels of canvas margin.

Latest fixed source snapshot: `658f6bd9e81bf51af64fbc4757e9bfacb7a74894`. All 38 file entries (36 unique blob objects) match local Git blob SHAs, and the complete remote tree is exactly `e20a8dfe423103a07cfb579c54fdde2d281fdb1a`, matching the local snapshot. This increment contains 9 valid RGBA PNGs (8 new-theme revision sheets plus the Qianyang repair) and 15 valid JSON records; PNG CRCs and decompressed RGBA dimensions validate.

Figma has separately recorded confirmations through batch 004 and Kaiming R04, including the 716-entry editable provisional catalogue and [research page 52](https://www.figma.com/design/e8ksDgxKC3OfMErZsjPpIO?node-id=291-2) / [Assets page 135](https://www.figma.com/design/e8ksDgxKC3OfMErZsjPpIO?node-id=291-30). Batch 005 Figma synchronization and the newest repair's confirmation are handled separately; their final confirmation metadata is not in this fixed source snapshot. GitHub archival is not evidence that Figma is complete. Raster images are not vectorized.

All 18 chapters and 822 paragraphs have an initial review. Identity disputes, catalogue deduplication, remaining anatomy/style checks and most of the generation queue are still pending. The 716 provisional entries are not completed characters, and the whole-book artwork collection is not complete.
